_doc: The policy of slicc_gate.py, read for every step SLICC's model wants to take. readonly_commands and browser_read_verbs run; stop_commands and stop_tools never run; opening an http(s) page (browser_navigate_verbs) runs unless it is a local address or names one (local_addresses, 2026-11-21); other browser verbs and every other command are asked. Reads in SLICC's workspace run, writes to control_paths never happen, writes under scratch_paths run. Paths are fnmatch globs (* also matches /). slicc7 is the same for SLICC seven (2026-11-18): its own tools and commands, its control paths, and every tool without a rule asked.

local_addresses._doc: Addresses of the machine's own network, which SLICC never opens by itself (an open is asked): networks by CIDR, exact hosts, host suffixes, and single-label names. Add your own network's names here (or in the policy CHANGE_GATE_POLICY names).

slicc.stop_reason: SLICC's cloud, devices, credentials, its own controls and memory stay off

slicc7._doc: SLICC seven: pi's coding tools (bash, read, write, edit) on a Linux-like kernel with users and sudo, plus codemode, memory_write, workflow, tool_search and licks. Read by slicc7_classify(). Paths are made absolute (relative to /home/cone) and normalised first.
slicc7.stop_reason: SLICC seven's controls, secrets, installs, devices, links, scoops and memory stay off
slicc7.secret_doc: 2026-11-21 (README "Logins on seven"): the credential commands secret_commands, and any command starting with a secret_command_prefixes entry, may only read a placeholder or a list (secret_read: each pattern is the command's words with no flag but --json, * one name that is not in secret_read_not_names). Anything else of theirs (create, reveal, refresh, rescope, import, export, a tab move) is stopped. They stay in stop_commands for a command the gate cannot read plainly. A vault placeholder (fnox_proxy_ and 24 hex digits) in a command is not a secret.
slicc7.session_doc: 2026-11-21 (README "Logins on seven"): in a job whose browser holds a signed-in session, session_stop_commands (they can drive the browser over CDP or read its cookies) are stopped, and so is every browser command verb outside session_browser_verbs (page JavaScript, cookies, storage, state, routes, downloads). Clicks and typing are asked as in every job.
slicc7.stop_tools_doc: codemode is one call whose script runs other tools that the model boundary never sees; it runs only where SLICC seven's owner tier files each nested call for this gate (mcp-slicc's common.classify_step).
